title: Jammy Sesame Seed Tamagoyaki
description: A paleo-friendly, crunchy, show-off Japanese dish featuring sesame seeds and a sweet strawberry jam inside tamagoyaki. Perfect for breakfast or dessert.
instructions: Preheat a frying pan to medium-high heat.
Sprinkle sesame seeds evenly over both tamagoyaki sheets.
Pour paleo-friendly flour-based batter onto one sheet, spreading it evenly.
Gently fold the other sheet over the batter-filled tamagoyaki.
Place folded tamagoyaki in hot pan with 2 tbsp of cooking oil.
Fry for about 30 seconds on each side until golden brown and crispy.
Spread strawberry jam evenly across one half of the fried tamagoyaki, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the opposite half over the jam to enclose it within the tamagoyaki.
Repeat process with remaining ingredients if desired.
Serve hot as a dessert or breakfast treat.
